svg.title: How much each field is used — SoftTrack web design mockup (#334)
svg.desc: Each field on the Fields settings page gains a use line: how many of the open tickets it applies to have a value. Opening it shows a breakdown by option, by person, or ticked against not, and when it last changed. The page counts and names no tickets; each count opens the list, filtered.
